title: Thomson Whisky (Willowbank) 21 YO Single Cask NZ 46% (GB)
seen_in_photos: Black glossy bottle with cream shaped label, black cardboard gift box, black capsule, back label with handwritten bottle and barrel numbers, barcode.
text_read: THOMSON WHISKY NEW ZEALAND LTD SINGLE MALT SINGLE CASK 21 YRS OLD 46% ABV. Back: Aged in oak for 21 years, limited edition NZ whisky, sea air nutmeg old wood nose, orange cacao cinnamon palate. No. OF BOTTLES 193 (handwritten) BARREL No. 169 (handwritten) NO CHILL FILTERING NO COLOURING. Distilled at Willowbank Distillery, Dunedin NZ. Contains approx 25 standard drinks. www.thomsonwhisky.com. Thomson Whisky Business Office, Victor Street, Auckland, PO Box 44356 Pt. Chev. AK 1246. 700ml. Barcode 9421902059094.
not_in_title: Barrel No. 169 only. Non chill filtered, no colouring. Bottle number not shown (193 is the outturn). Otherwise the title is complete.
reason: Title already gives distillery, age, single cask, ABV and outturn. Only the barrel number is extra. Willowbank is a closed Dunedin distillery, but the title already says so.
bottling_era: Modern, about 2020s (barcode, 700ml, standard drinks panel, Pt Chev address). Willowbank distilled 1990s.
condition: Capsule intact, fill into neck, appears full, no label damage seen.

title: Thomson Whisky (Willowbank) 23 YO Single Cask NZ 46% (GB)

not_in_title: Barrel No. 112. Back label says it is the most mature vintage released by Thomson Whisky to date (oldest release), which the title does not say.
reason: Title is complete. Small extras: barrel number 112 and the 'most mature release to date' claim, which may interest NZ collectors.
condition: Capsule intact with small mark on capsule, fill in neck, no damage seen.

title: Tyrconnell 16 YO Single Malt Irish Whiskey, County Louth
seen_in_photos: Bottle with grey/green foil capsule, braided cord and hang tag on neck, grey front label with horse race roundel, copper plaque, grey cardboard tube alongside, back label with barcode. Fill in the neck, slightly below the shoulder of the neck.
text_read: THE TYRCONNELL SINGLE MALT IRISH WHISKEY AGED 16 YEARS. ANDREW A. WATT & CO. EST. 1762 Crafting fine whiskey for over two centuries. Product of Ireland. 70 cl, alc. 46% vol. Back: matured in American White Oak ex-bourbon barrels. COOLEY DISTILLERY, RIVERSTOWN, DUNDALK, COUNTY LOUTH, IRELAND. www.drinksmart.com, www.tyrconnellwhiskey.com. Barcode 5099357091408. Colour note: Mit Farbstoff (Zuckerkulor), Farven justeret med caramel. Tube: 70 cl, alc. 46% vol. Hang tag 16 years 1762.
not_in_title: Cooley Distillery, ex-bourbon American oak, 46%, 70cl, tube included. Contains added caramel colouring. Era is the Beam Suntory era (drinksmart text), not the Teeling relaunch.
reason: Current standard 16 YO release, accurately described. Caramel colour note and fill sit a little low in the neck, so no hidden value.
bottling_era: Around 2010s to early 2020s: EU-style 70cl/46% label, drinksmart.com, caramel colouring statement, Beam era Cooley.
condition: Fill about base of neck, a little ullage but ordinary. Capsule intact. Tube is not mentioned in title.

title: Tyrconnell 3 Stars Inaugural Release Limited Edition Pure Pot Still Irish Whiskey, Circa 1993 (GB) (Celebrating Relaunch by John Teeling)
seen_in_photos: Pale green front label with horse race scene ('Tyrconnell wins! 100 tol.'), three red stars, gold capsule with a small tear, neck collar label, burgundy faux leather gift box with gold lettering, back label history. Fill in lower neck, about base of neck.
text_read: THE TYRCONNELL *** SINGLE MALT. PURE POT STILL IRISH WHISKEY. Distilled matured and bottled in Ireland by Andrew A. Watt & Co., Dundalk Ireland. Established 1762. No. TC 0295 of 5000. 70 cl, 40% vol. Product of Ireland. Back label: in the Northwest corner of Ireland lies Tyrconnell (Gaelic for the land of the O'Donnells)... established 1762 Watt family... To taste The Tyrconnell Single Malt is to experience centuries of craftsmanship. Box: THE TYRCONNELL *** IRISH WHISKEY.
not_in_title: Individually numbered: bottle No. TC 0295 of 5000. 40% vol 70cl. Label says 'Single Malt' and 'Pure Pot Still' (a contradiction). Collectable early Cooley era Tyrconnell.
reason: Numbered edition 0295 of 5000 is not in the title, and early Cooley era Tyrconnell is a niche collectable. Title is otherwise accurate, so only a modest hidden value. Minor warnings: slight capsule tear and fill at base of neck.
bottling_era: Circa 1990s (Webb's says 1993; relaunch era, 70cl, 40%, boxed). Label has barcode-free front and no EU colouring text visible on back.
condition: Capsule with small tear/mark, fill at base of neck to upper shoulder gap, some label age marks.

unreadable: Back labels, ABVs, batch details and bottle fills inside boxes are not visible. Small print on boxes is too small to read.
